title: 天马园值班表
subtitle: 真正的本领，藏在每天的照顾里
origin: 《西游记》第四回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 每一份工作都有价值；先了解责任、互相尊重，才能把本领用在真正需要的地方。
moral.en: Every job matters. Understanding responsibilities and respecting one another helps us use our skills where they are truly needed.

pages.zh: 悟空第一次来到天宫，接到一项新任务：照看会踏云的天马园。
pages.en: On his first visit to Heaven, Wukong received a new task: caring for a stable of cloud-treading horses.
pages.prompt: Sun Wukong, a small golden-brown monkey in a golden-yellow tunic, vermilion sash and dark red trousers with no headband yet, enters a bright celestial stable filled with friendly white horses with pale-gold manes standing safely on low soft clouds; warm welcome, no weapons or text.

pages.zh: 旧值班表只写着“喂草、关门”，却没有标明每匹马喜欢的食物和休息时间。
pages.en: The old duty board only said “feed” and “close,” without noting what each horse liked or when it needed rest.
pages.prompt: Wukong studies a blank-symbol wooden duty board beside several friendly celestial horses choosing hay, apples, or water; use only simple colored shapes with no readable writing, thoughtful storybook scene, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空先不急着显本领。他跟着马儿走了一整天，记下谁怕响声、谁爱慢慢吃。
pages.en: Instead of showing off, Wukong followed the horses for a whole day, noticing who disliked noise and who preferred to eat slowly.
pages.prompt: Wukong quietly observes three distinct gentle celestial horses in a peaceful cloud pasture, one resting away from bells, one eating slowly, one drinking; careful listening and observation, no text.

pages.zh: 他用月亮、太阳、苹果和水滴图案，做了一张人人都看得懂的新值班表。
pages.en: He made a new duty board with moons, suns, apples, and water drops that everyone could understand.
pages.prompt: Wukong arranges large carved picture tokens shaped like sun, moon, apple, and water drop on a wooden board while friendly stable helpers watch; icons only, no letters or readable text.

pages.zh: 八匹天马也被分成小组：晨风队先散步，晚霞队多休息，星点队轮流梳毛。
pages.en: The horses formed small groups: Dawn Breeze walked early, Sunset rested longer, and Starlight took turns being brushed.
pages.prompt: Three small groups of friendly white celestial horses follow a calm routine across a golden cloud stable: walking, resting, and receiving gentle grooming; Wukong coordinates cheerfully, no text.

pages.zh: 几天后，天马精神十足，马厩也不再手忙脚乱。大家第一次看清这份工作的学问。
pages.en: Within days, the horses were thriving and the stable ran calmly. Everyone finally saw how much skill the work required.
pages.prompt: Orderly celestial stable at sunrise, healthy horses with shining pale-gold manes, helpers calmly following picture tokens, Wukong smiling with quiet pride; no text.

pages.zh: 悟空也认真问清自己的职责和称呼。玉帝答应以后先说明任务，再安排合适的位置。
pages.en: Wukong also asked clearly about his role and title. The Jade Emperor agreed to explain each task before assigning a position.
pages.prompt: Kind Jade Emperor in ivory-and-pale-gold cloud robes and tall jade crown speaks at equal eye level with Wukong beside the stable, both using open respectful gestures; horses nearby, no throne or text.

pages.zh: 离开天马园时，悟空把值班表交给新管事：“照顾得好，就是了不起的本领。”
pages.en: Before leaving, Wukong handed the board to the new keeper. “Caring well is a remarkable skill.”
pages.prompt: Wukong hands the picture-token duty board to a smiling celestial stable keeper as friendly horses nuzzle nearby under peach-colored clouds; warm handoff and farewell, no text.
